rationale: Recent broad curriculum and export reallocations regressed, so the intended change was to keep the winning reverse-tail recurrent family intact while narrowing late EMA tracking to quant-sensitive tail tensors, recurrent control tensors, skip weights, and late V/proj path tensors. That targets the exact int8 roundtrip endgame without another large structural rewrite.
title: Tail-Focused EMA for Recurrent Export Path
